experiment_data.hypothesis: The correlation-selection gap (high QE correlation but no selection gain) generalizes to 32B-scale models. Qwen2.5-32B QLoRA fine-tuned on FewNERD should show the same pattern: structural signals have high ρ but fail at instance-level selection, while entity construction (θ=2/N) provides significant F1 gain. This fills the 8B→72B scale gap.
